name: SOF lateral spine radiographs (Study of Osteoporotic Fractures)
what: the women's counterpart of MrOS: lateral thoracolumbar films at several visits, about 9,700 women, Genant grading per vertebra; counts to confirm on the page
level_truth: Genant grades on named levels, so level truth exists
licence: a SOF data request agreement; terms to confirm on the page
how_to_get: Open https://sofonline.ucsf.edu/ and read the data request route, to confirm on the page.
The owner files the request in the owner's name and signs whatever agreement follows; a session drafts the proposal text once the owner asks.
Once granted, fetch by the route the centre gives, as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node.
source_status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; the same kind of request as MrOS (to confirm on the page), not sent; with MrOS the largest level-labelled lateral spine film resource that exists

history.note: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; the same kind of request as MrOS (to confirm on the page), not sent; with MrOS the largest level-labelled lateral spine film resource that exists

owner's sitting prepared: SOF Online has the same gate as MrOS: an authorization email from an institutional address to sofdata@ucsf.edu with full name and every institutional affiliation, then the registration form (Email, Password, First Name, Middle Initial, Last Name, Institution, Position) and a box accepting the limited data set agreement; the authorization email is drafted in the owner's Outlook Drafts and says the MrOS request goes in parallel

the SOF coordinating centre answered the owner's email: SOF Online is closed to registrations while it is updated for new NIH requirements and will write when it reopens; the study images are being added to the NIA Aging Research Biobank (https://agingresearchbiobank.nia.nih.gov), which already holds them, so the images are requested from the Biobank, which gives the timeline, transfer, any fees and the terms of use

obstacles: SOF Online is closed to registrations until it is updated for new NIH requirements
the images are requested from the NIA Aging Research Biobank, a request in the owner's name whose terms and any fee are his to accept
next: the owner submits a request for the SOF lateral spine images through the NIA Aging Research Biobank (https://agingresearchbiobank.nia.nih.gov), which gives the timeline, transfer, fees and terms; SOF Online's reopening is a second route
